next_step.title: Read the next thin colleges
next_step.text: Sierra, Reedley and MiraCosta are next on the thin list; read the host's own outline first, then a capture-only read, then extract under the 40 dollar go.

calls.title: The second reader waits on the xAI API billing moving to the district card
calls.text: Sam, 2026-10-20 about 16:30 UTC: the API is paid for separately from the Grok subscription, and the account is moving to the RCCD district credit card, which will take some time. When the key exists: Sam sets XAI_API_KEY and XAI_MODEL as Edge Function secrets on the Work Plan project, a session deploys program-requirements-extract with cpl-chat-deploy.yml, then runs second-reader.yml for Canada College.
calls.no_reply: The second reader stays built and unrun; the records that fail a machine check are read by one model and Jev's sittings, whose verdicts files carry each college's next fix.

notes.addenda: The eight addenda amending loaded colleges' catalogs were read on Oct 14 and filed on Oct 14 as read, each with the programs and courses it changes. The other 71 listed addenda wait for the reader to reach their colleges.

changes.text: The reader now keeps a Requirements tab whose course numbers carry a campus letter, as the Ventura district prints them.
Moorpark, Oxnard and Ventura read again and loaded: 209 new records, 100, 86 and 121 passing the machine checks, about 32 dollars in extraction.
